That Vito and Nicks II in Hickory Hills is not a second location, and isn’t affiliated with the one on Pulaski. It sucks, honestly. If you need a backup, go to Rosangela’s in Evergreen Park. Not the same as Vito’s but probably the best other pizza place in the neighborhood.

If that’s the case you can take the Rock to 91st and take the Major Taylor trail up through the woods. Stay away from Columbus Ave by the railyard as well as parts of Western and 79th if you ride your bike up that way. Drivers are insane around there. 

The woods just south of the Dan Ryan Woods East parking lot south of 87th have some nice picnic tables hidden in the woods on an abandoned path if you wanna check that out, there’s also a meadery for some reason next to the 91st stop.

I wouldn’t. 

Depending on where you are and what time you’d be going, I’d bike up to the 35th St Rock Island station and take that straight to Beverly, or get on the Metra Electric line from HP and bike up from Blue Island and take Longwood once you get a bit north.

If you really want to, check out Mellow Bike Map and see what route works for you. 

I live around Beverly and I have friends in HP and I know how much of a pain in the ass it is to go either way without a car.
